home.manifestoCol1: A network of companies, shared workspaces, an education that doesn't end in the classroom: they are not elements alongside the course of study — they are an integral part of it. Studying and entering the industry happen in the same place.
home.manifestoCol2: Students work side by side with people already in the industry — in the same network of companies, in the same spaces. Not an internship at the end of the course, but a constant condition: education stays anchored to what the market demands today, not to a syllabus fixed years ago.
